creativeDirection: Brokers and shipping teams keep a network of transporters’ reported space, routes and approximate locations in one view. Grounded East African freight-yard artwork; minimal text; tracking secondary.

en.teaser: Work better with transporters to serve your customers. See which vehicles are available as your transporters post updates. Once the job is agreed, follow the shipment and keep your customers informed. loadgistic.com
en.private-network: See the available space your transporters share with your team. Check their latest updates in your Private Network before you call to confirm the job. loadgistic.com
en.transporter: Manage your vehicles and drivers, and share available space with the brokers and shipping teams you work with. Choose who can see it. Once work is agreed, give customers private tracking. loadgistic.com
en.public-discovery: Your usual transporter cannot take this load? Explore public capacity by route, vehicle type and current load. Check when the signal was updated, then call the provider to confirm the work. loadgistic.com
en.tracking: The job is agreed. Keep everyone in the picture. Give the people involved private shipment updates, approximate location and loading and unloading photos—without making the shipment public. loadgistic.com

schedule.purpose: Introduce how brokers and shipping teams use the capacity their transporters share.
Show transporters how to report space and choose who can see it.
Use an actual shared-map recording with a synthetic business account; show the practical recipient view. No fabricated app UI.
Show actual route/space filtering, signal age and direct contact. No guaranteed availability.
Remind brokers and shipping teams how to keep their transporters in view; do not invent a launch date.
Report the actual testing/review state. This schedule does not start Google’s enrolled-testing clock.

publishing.accounts: Owner will create Loadgistic TikTok/Instagram accounts; no handles assumed and no posts published.
publishing.aiDisclosure: Generated realistic freight artwork is AI-assisted. Use the applicable platform AI-generated/AI-info label; do not present it as customer footage.
publishing.music: Export is silent. Add business-cleared music in each platform’s native editor; do not assume one platform’s track license carries to the other.
publishing.review: Review the final post preview and text visibility before publication.
publishing.downloadBadge: Do not display a Google Play download badge or claim public store availability until the actual public release is available.
publishing.testerLink: Use the actual closed-test opt-in link only after Google makes that release available; eligibility is not enrollment.
